[[File:Erina.png|thumb|250px|Erina]] '''Erina''' (Japanese: '''エリナ''' ''Erina'') is a [[Pokémon Trainer]] and a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[BW051|Lost at the Stamp Rally!]]''. Erina was first seen searching for her lost {{p|Axew}} in [[Battle Subway|Gear Station]]. Eventually, she asked {{an|Cilan}} for help as he gathered stamps for the [[Subway Bosses' Stamp Rally]]. He accompanied her on her search, and they eventually found a note posted as a clue to Axew's location, which had been left by {{an|Iris}} and {{Ash}}. Cilan asked [[Emmet]] and [[Ingo]] to help them track down Axew's location. They quickly locate Axew, who was reunited with Erina. However, with all of the time spent searching for Axew, Cilan had failed to complete his own goal, to collect all of the stamps he needed to battle Ingo and Emmet. Erina allowed him to have her stamp sheet, which had the stamp Cilan required to complete the Stamp Rally. She watched the battle alongside Iris, and afterwards, the four of them rode the Ferris wheel together. ==Pokémon== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Erina |pkmn=Axew |gender=female |type1=Dragon |epnum=BW051 |epname=Lost at the Stamp Rally! |img=Erina Axew.png |vajp=Chinami Nishimura |vaen=Kayzie Rogers |desc={{p|Axew}} was somehow separated from Erina and was found by {{Ash}} who mistook her for [[Iris's Axew]]. The only way she could be told apart was the pink bow on her tail. She stuck with Iris and Ash who wanted to help her find her Trainer. She accidentally mistook another Trainer to be Erina and ended up being tied up by her {{p|Swadloon}}. In the end, Axew was reunited with her Trainer. She reappeared in a flashback in ''[[BW065|Battling the Bully!]]''. None of Axew's moves are known.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{dragon color}}|bordercolor={{dragon color light}} |ja=津田美波 ''[[Minami Tsuda]]'' |en=Kate Peterson |es_la=Leyla Rangel |es_eu=Ainhoa Martín |fi=Saara Lehtonen |it=Jolanda Granato |pt_br=Bianca Alencar |pl=Anna Wodzyńska}}
